# dify_model_provider_credential (Resource)

Manages a model provider credential in Dify. `provider_name` is the provider path such as `langgenius/openai/openai`. Credential values are write-only: the API never returns them, so state keeps the configured values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Provider-level credential, e.g. an OpenAI API key shared by all models
# of the provider.
resource "dify_model_provider_credential" "openai" {
  provider_name = "langgenius/openai/openai"
  name          = "production-key"
  make_active   = true

  credentials = {
    openai_api_key = var.openai_api_key
  }
}

variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive) Credential key-value pairs keyed by the provider's credential form fields (e.g. `openai_api_key`). Write-only and sensitive.
- `provider_name` (String) Model provider id (e.g. `langgenius/openai/openai`).

### Optional

- `make_active` (Boolean) Make this credential the provider's active one after every create/update (POST .../credentials/{credential_id}:activate).
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for this credential.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this is the provider's active credential.
- `credential_id` (String) Credential ID (assigned by Dify after creation).
